messages:
maya-partnerops: FYI - ACME Hardware reached out. They want marketplace onboarding but their connector emits minute-level usage and the seller portal expects hourly entitlements. Need plan for reconciliation and test harness. cc @raj-eng @sara-billing
raj-eng: Can you paste a sample minute payload? Also do they include device_id and sku?
maya-partnerops: sample payload below they sent in email: ```{
  "device_id": "dev-42",
  "sku": "acme-pro",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-17T13:07:00Z",
  "usage_minutes": 1
}``` They batch to S3 every 5 minutes and call our webhook when batches land.
sara-billing: Important: billing expects hours summed and rounded to nearest minute before summing. If they send minute counts we should sum minute-level usage per SKU per UTC hour. Also we need idempotency keys for replay safety.
raj-eng: Agreed. Two engineering asks: (1) ingest adapter to accept minute-level rows and roll up to hour windows; (2) keep raw minute rows for audit in cold storage for 90 days. Do we have consensus on late-arrival rules?
maya-partnerops: Partner wants 24h window for late arrivals; marketplace policy is 48h for external partners. Suggest we support 48h but surface late data to seller portal as "post-cut" adjustments.
oliver-ps: From product side we need seller-facing change logs when entitlements shift post-cut. Also UI shows hourly buckets; do we keep a debug view for minute diffs?
raj-eng: We'll add a debug flag to the partner dashboard. Implementation notes: use UTC-aligned hour windows, sum usage_minutes, emit an hourly usage event with schema: ```{
  "sku": "acme-pro",
  "hour_start": "2026-03-17T13:00:00Z",
  "usage_minutes": 45,
  "source_raw_count": 45,
  "ingest_id": "<uuid>"
}``` Include ingestion signature header X-Redwood-Signature.
chun-qa: For QA we need test vectors: (a) 5-minute batch with duplicate rows, (b) out-of-order minute rows arriving 3 hours late, (c) DST edge though we'll normalize to UTC. I'll write tests for dedupe and 48h-late acceptance.
sara-billing: Also need to define reconciliation window and tolerance. Proposal: nightly reconciliation job that compares marketplace-seller-reported entitlements vs internal rolled-up hours. Tolerance = 0.5% for volume-based vs threshold, otherwise escalate.
maya-partnerops: Partner-side constraints: their devices can be offline and do backfill windows up to 36h. We'll communicate our 48h acceptance and ask them to prioritize under-24h if possible.
raj-eng: Implementation plan: adapter accepts minute payloads, does streaming dedupe using (device_id, timestamp, sku) as key, writes raw to cold S3, writes rollup to hourly table, emits event to metering bus. Fallback: if we get only hourly files, pass through.
oliver-ps: Can we also expose a webhook for partners to receive reconciliation diff reports daily? That helps ACME ops reconcile credits.
sara-billing: Yes - partner webhook for diffs sounds good. Make sure webhook payload includes run_id, hour_start, delta_minutes, reason_code.
deploy-bot: webhook-delivery: delivery failure to acme-webhook (http 502) for run_id run-20260317-13 at 2026-03-18T05:12:09Z
maya-partnerops: noted - ops will retry and follow up with partner.
chun-qa: QA checklist items created: dedupe test, late-arrival 0/24/48/72 permutations, webhook retry behavior, signature verification.
raj-eng: Timeline: spike this week for adapter + unit tests, run against partner sandbox next Tue. I'll own the spike.
sara-billing: I'll add billing regression tests to ensure no double-counting in invoicing if partner backfills.
maya-partnerops: Action items: @raj-eng implement adapter spike, @chun-qa create test vectors, @sara-billing create reconciliation playbook, I'll schedule partner sandbox test and kick off go/no-go.
oliver-ps: +1 to that plan. Also I'll draft the seller-portal delta UI spec.
maya-partnerops: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: Will post partner onboarding doc link when ready.
